title: Brief transdiagnostic blended therapy for emotional disorders: a waitlist-controlled pilot study
summary: TONI compact is a scientific study at Psychologische Hochschule Berlin. The study investigates if a combination of three psychotherapy sessions with the therapeutic online-tool TONI reduces anxiety or depression. Patients will either be randomly assigned to a group that starts treatment immediately, or to a group that starts treatment after a delay of 10 weeks.
conditions: Major depression (current depressive episode or recurrent)
Anxiety disorder (panic disorder, agora phobia, GAS, social anxiety disorder, specific phobia)
Adjustment disorder with depressed mood and/or anxiety

interventions.name:

Waitlist control group:

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
- current depressive disorder and/or anxiety disorder or adjustment disorder with depressed mood and/or anxiety based on the structured clinical interview for DSM (SCID-1)
- public health insurance
- ability to attend three in-person psychotherapy sessions in Berlin
- stable internet connection at home and a digital device
- sufficient knowledge of German
- ability to read and write
Exclusion criteria:
- psychotherapy (currently or in the following 6 months)
- change in psychotropic medication in the last three months
- severe mental distress because of different symptoms than anxiety or depression (e.g., psychotic/manic symptoms, addiction) that cannot be managed sufficiently in the study
- suicidality (score of 2 or more on item 9 of the PHQ-9 "Thoughts that you would be better off dead or of hurting yourself in some way")
